'''Pratt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. A junior officer in [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Grol]]'s unit, after Grol's [[Death/Legends|death]] he clashed with Sergeant [[Tegan]] over who would assume command of the unit and continue their mission to extract [[Padrus Organa]] from [[House Alde (estate)|House Alde]].
